description: Defines an interface IReminderTestGrain for reminder-related operations in Orleans grains, including methods to check existence, add, and remove reminders.

classes.name: IReminderTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for reminder management in grain objects, extending IGrainWithIntegerKey to specify grain identity by integer key.

methods.name: IsReminderExists
methods.description: Checks if a reminder with the specified name exists.

methods.name: AddReminder
methods.description: Adds a new reminder with the specified name.

methods.name: RemoveReminder
methods.description: Removes the reminder with the specified name.
